help_content: ❓ Help & Support 🔹 How does it work? Describe your need, receive quotes from verified providers, pay securely through the NEXIS HUB escrow — funds are only released to the provider after your confirmation. 🔹 Is payment secure? Yes. Your funds stay held until you confirm the mission is properly completed. 🔹 Problem with a mission? Use the report button on the mission in question, or contact us directly. 📱 Contact us: +243 852 638 209

help_faq_2_a: Yes. Your funds stay held until you confirm the mission is properly completed.
